description: This file defines the CanvasWindowController class, which manages a macOS window containing a WKWebView for rendering a web-based canvas interface. It handles loading URLs or files, setting up JavaScript bridges, and managing viewer interactions within the application.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A controller managing a macOS window with a WKWebView for displaying and interacting with web-based canvas content.

methods.name: applyPreferredPlacement
methods.description: Sets the preferred placement of the canvas window.

methods.name: showCanvas
methods.description: Displays the canvas window, optionally loading a specific path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a specified URL, file, or route into the web view.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status overlay with optional titles.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Applies the current debug status settings to the web view.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads a local file URL into the web view.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript in the web view and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the web view content and saves it as a PNG image.

methods.name: directoryPath
methods.description: Returns the file system directory path associated with this canvas session.

methods.name: shouldAutoNavigateToA2UI
methods.description: Determines whether to auto-navigate to A2UI based on current and last target URL.
